commands.name: open-resume
commands.title: Open Resume
commands.description: Open a resume by providing a JSON resume URL

tools.name: text-to-resume
tools.title: Convert Text to JSON Resume
tools.description: Validates and formats JSON Resume data extracted from user-provided text. Returns JSON; optionally saves a new file at an explicitly requested path.

ai.instructions: When users ask to convert a resume, CV, bio, or section to JSON Resume, extract their supplied facts into a JSON Resume object and call text-to-resume with resumeJson containing the serialized JSON. Use basics.url, work.name/work.url, and education.score. Include all relevant standard sections (basics, work, volunteer, education, projects, awards, certificates, publications, skills, languages, interests, references). Preserve date precision (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD); omit unknown fields and never invent dates or facts. Correct validation errors and retry. Present the returned JSON to the user. Set outputPath only when the user explicitly requests a file at that path. The tool does not copy to the clipboard or save to the resume URL collection.
